# vexoro

> vexoro builds AI solutions for companies in Oman and worldwide: AI assistants, workflow automation, document processing and custom AI integrations. We also design the brand and build the website around them.

Contact: hello@vexoro.dev

## Pages

- [Home](https://vexoro.dev/): services, process, SEO approach, FAQ and contact form
- [AI Solutions](https://vexoro.dev/ai): AI assistants, automation, document processing, knowledge assistants, custom AI and strategy
- [Pricing](https://vexoro.dev/pricing): website packages and add-ons in Omani rial (OMR)
- [Brand & Web](https://vexoro.dev/services): branding and website services with typical timelines
- [Process](https://vexoro.dev/process): how a project runs, from brief to launch
- [SEO](https://vexoro.dev/seo): the search setup included with every site
- [FAQ](https://vexoro.dev/faq): cost, SEO, ownership, editing and timelines
- [Contact](https://vexoro.dev/contact): start a project or book a free consultation

## AI solutions

AI assistants for websites and WhatsApp, workflow automation across email, spreadsheets and CRMs, document processing (invoices, forms, contracts), private knowledge assistants, custom AI features and AI strategy workshops. Quoted per project after a free consultation.

## Website packages (OMR)

- Starter, 15 OMR: 1 custom webpage, responsive, business information, contact details, WhatsApp button, social media links, 1 revision
- Business, 30 OMR (most popular): up to 4 pages, custom design, contact form, WhatsApp integration, Google Maps, social media integration, basic SEO setup, simple animations, 2 revisions
- Professional, 50 OMR: up to 7 pages, premium custom design, advanced animations, contact forms, WhatsApp, Google Maps, SEO setup, performance optimisation, custom features, 3 revisions, priority support
- Elite, from 75 OMR: custom number of pages, fully custom UI/UX, custom functionality, advanced forms, SEO and performance optimisation, third-party integrations, priority support, unlimited revisions (price depends on requirements)

## Add-ons (OMR)

- Additional page: 5
- Premium animations: from 10
- Advanced contact / booking system: from 10
- Custom functionality: from 10
- SEO optimisation: from 10
- Website maintenance: 5 per month
- Domain & hosting setup: from 5

## Services

Brand websites, landing pages, online stores, web apps, technical SEO audits and website care plans. Every site ships with page titles and descriptions, social preview images, schema.org data, a sitemap, robots.txt, compressed images and Google Search Console setup.
